SELECT (SELECT COUNT(p.id) FROM plans p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS plans, (SELECT COUNT(r.id) FROM plan_revisions r JOIN plans p ON p.id = r.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS plan_revisions, (SELECT COUNT(t.id) FROM todos t JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS todos, (SELECT COUNT(r.id) FROM todo_revisions r JOIN todos t ON t.id = r.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS todo_revisions, (SELECT COUNT(tt.todo_id) FROM todo_tags tt JOIN todos t ON t.id = tt.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS todo_tags, (SELECT COUNT(g.id) FROM tags g WHERE g.user_id = #{userId}) AS tags, (SELECT COUNT(e.id) FROM execution_logs e JOIN todos t ON t.id = e.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS execution_logs, (SELECT COUNT(c.id) FROM completion_events c JOIN todos t ON t.id = c.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS completion_events, (SELECT COUNT(o.id) FROM reopen_events o JOIN todos t ON t.id = o.todo_id JOIN plans p ON p.id = t.plan_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}) AS reopen_events, (SELECT COUNT(v.id) FROM reviews v WHERE v.user_id = #{userId}) AS reviews
